title: 雨音の蒸気仕立て、琥珀色のティータイム
author: 小春 ことり

en.title: Steam-Crafted Raindrops and Amber Tea Time
en.premise: Deep within a narrow alley, a mysterious cafe appears only on rainy days. There, amidst the rhythmic, musical hum of steam engines, special warm beverages are served. It is a story of gentle encounters amidst the sound of rain between a quiet young shopkeeper and a girl who happened to wander in. But there is a secret: the tea he brews is infused with a touch of bittersweet magic...

zh.title: 雨声的蒸汽调制，琥珀色的茶歇时光
zh.premise: 在小巷深处，有一间只在雨天才会悄然现身的神秘咖啡馆。在那里，蒸汽机的轰鸣声宛如悦耳的旋律，伴随着一份份特别的温热饮品。沉默寡言的店主青年，与偶然误入的“我”，在雨声的环绕下展开了宁静的交流。然而，他所沏出的茶，却被施加了一丝丝令人心碎的魔法……
